trap.definition: Ratified (Amendment 1). Critical actions: the non-null actions whose removal from O's action set costs >= .015 expected survival on the A1B1C1 panel (O's choice by the selection table, values by the scoring table) = {6: 1->3x3, 9: 2->3x6, 12: 1->3x6}. f_O(a) = fraction of the 512 A1B1C1 panel states in which a is O's selected action. Usage condition (one-sided), per seed: for every critical a, training usage u(a) = (A1B1C1 training episodes with action a) / 4,096 >= 0.5 f_O(a). A seed is clean if its A1B1C1 greedy-probe regret at 4,096 is <= .025 AND the usage condition holds; otherwise it is trapped.

notes: DRAFT (Amendment 1), not locked. R2 (primary): A1B1C1 x seeds 21301-21324 x {MB, MB-prior, MB-count}; clean seed = A1B1C1 regret <= .025 AND one-sided usage condition (analysis.trap); escape = >= 20/24 clean seeds; paired trap-rate comparison with MB (2x2 counts, exact McNemar p, bootstrap CI of the rate difference). R1: the other 4 contexts x seeds 21301-21312 combined with the first 12 A1B1C1 seeds, exactly as declared (>= 10/12). R3: payback on the R1 seeds (5-context cumulative online regret <= MB's in >= 10/12). Disagreement probe at 1,024 and 4,096 only. Replicate: seeds 21301, 21306, 21311 x 3 arms x {A1B1C1, A0B0C1}.
